encounters.weakness: Sulfur Core Staff energy pulse (direct hit on the staff's core causes 1.5x damage and staggers the enemy).

Vulnerable to Ashen Breath Vial. When the vial is activated during combat, it causes the entity to split into two mirrored forms, each staggered for 3 seconds and taking 40% damage. Can only be used once per encounter.

Vulnerable only when the Stilled Flame Orb is activated. When the orb is used at the exact moment of a major attack (e.g., a phase shift or energy surge), the Core experiences a moment of stillness. During this, it takes 2x damage and becomes stunned for 5 seconds.
Ignition Core (player weapon) - a directed pulse disables its flame resonance. Misuse causes backfire burn damage.
Burnt Data Chip (pickup from previous encounter) — activation causes chaotic fire behavior and disorientation. If not used, whispers grow louder and cause mental drain.
Burnt Data Chip (must be held in hand during final attack) — triggers reverse resonance, shattering the core. Failure results in absorption of player's fire and instant death.

Light exposure. The Whisperer cannot move in direct sunlight or any light source. Shadowblade's blade emits a faint pulse of light when held in darkness — when the player activates it, the enemy is temporarily blinded and weakens by 25% for 3 seconds.

Shadowblade's blade must be held in a *horizontal* orientation. When the blade is held horizontally, it emits a low-frequency hum that causes the Stalker to stagger. If the player holds the blade horizontally during attack, the enemy takes 30% damage and is slowed for 2 seconds. This ability is only active after the player acquires the Flicker Shard and uses it once to activate the blade's resonance.
The Hollow Echo is vulnerable to the Resonance Core. When the player uses the Resonance Core *while in direct proximity* (within 2 meters), the entity's form flickers, revealing a weak point.
Cold-Bore Scout Rifle (direct fire at close range causes 1.5x damage and slows movement for 2 seconds after hit).
Thermal Flare (used during the first encounter). When the Thermal Flare is active and the player fires their rifle at the drone, it freezes for 2 seconds and emits a low-frequency echo.
Bio-Stabilizer Gel applied to the rifle. When the gel is active and the player fires at the Watcher, it creates a feedback pulse that temporarily disrupts the entity's perception.
The Bone Chisel (player's weapon) deals 2x damage when used on this enemy. The Shade flickers when struck by bone, and its form begins to dissolve.
The Gravehowl is vulnerable to sound. The player's Soul Shard (Flicker) can be used to emit a faint echo. When the echo plays, the enemy stumbles and is weakened for 2 turns.
The Warden is vulnerable when the player uses the **Ashen Vow (Fragile)**. When activated, it emits a corrupted chant that causes the Warden to shudder, drop its armor, and expose its core.
The player's Searing Fang must be swung in a spiral motion to trigger a feedback burst. When hit with the weapon in this motion, the enemy explodes into shrapnel and short-circuits its core.

The Hollow Tether can only be injured if the player uses the Cord of Shattered Static to strike it with a full swing of their Searing Fang. The static pulse must hit the enemy's core (a glowing black eye).

The boss is vulnerable only when struck with the **Tear of the First Fall**, pressed directly against its core. The tear must be used *during* a 10-second window when the boss emits a low-frequency hum.

The Frostshard Blade deals 3x damage to Echo-Fog Wraiths. Frostshard Blade is a weapon of frozen silence; the wraiths cannot move or speak when the blade strikes, creating a moment of stillness in the fog.

The Crimson Bell-Drum is weakened when the player uses the Frost Shard to pause time and strikes it while the bell is in a 'resting' state. This state occurs when the enemy's bell is silent and frozen — only reachable when the player pauses time after a successful hit.
The Watcher is vulnerable only when the player uses the Whispered Chime to activate a memory loop and strikes it during a moment of total silence.
The player's Singing Teacup. When the cup is used to create a mirror illusion, the Groom's laughter is reflected back — shattering his form briefly.
The player's Mirror Shard (Frayed). When the player uses the shard to project a duplicate of themselves (an illusion), the Merchant's glass shop begins to flicker and collapse.
The player must use the **Singing Mirror (Rusted)** to project a harmonious, synchronized illusion of the entire carnival. When this illusion plays, the Heart's core pulses and begins to shatter.
Player's primary tool: Steam Hammer. Direct hammer strikes cause mechanical failure and reduce damage output by 50% for 2 seconds.
Weak to the 'Piston Surge Injector'. Using the injector on this enemy applies a pressure overload that deals 25% extra damage and disables its steam absorption for 4 seconds.

Weak to the 'Piston Surge Injector' — must be used to overload its central core. Using it applies a sustained pressure surge that deals 40% extra damage and disables its environmental control for 6 seconds. This is the only way to defeat it.
Gear-Spark Pistol (sonic disruption of gear mechanisms)
Steam Condenser Core (disables steam pressure buildup)
Steam Condenser Core (must be placed into the central frequency slot to disrupt its self-replicating code; only works if obtained from Encounter 1).
Flicker Flask (causes the Sprout to burst into steam, causing it to freeze mid-sprout and become passive for 3 turns).
Molten Marmalade Shard (the Shard causes the Wheel to emit a shriek and spin backward, temporarily slowing it by 50% for 2 turns).
Cogs of Confusion (when placed in the dragon's crown — it must be used during the final turn — the dragon freezes, its gears stop, and it becomes vulnerable to a single burst from the Flicker Flask).
Steam-Cracked Cogblade (cog teeth trigger a steam burst that disorients the enemy for 2 seconds, reducing its attack speed by 30%)
Oiled Brass Sprocket (when the sprocket is held up to the gaunt's armored joints, it emits a grinding noise that causes the gaunt to momentarily freeze in place and drop its weapon for 2 seconds)

Copper Wire from a Dead Steam Core (when the wire is ignited by the player placing it directly over the core's central gear, it produces a spark that for 4 seconds disables the Gears' central processing)
inventory: Copper Wire from a Dead Steam Core

encounters.weakness: Stormspike's static pulse (when used in short bursts at close range). The enemy's copper body absorbs and reflects electricity; rapid pulses of the Stormspike disrupt its internal circuits, causing short-circuiting and paralysis for 1.5 seconds.

The player must use the **Conductor's Shard** to activate a temporary 'storm resonance' by placing it near the enemy's core. When activated, the Overlord's body emits a crackling static surge, and the player can then use a **double-strike** with Stormspike.

The player must **activate the Tangled Wire** (a pickup from the second encounter) during the final battle. Once placed in the Stormspike's core, it creates a temporary 'storm bridge' between the player and the Architect.
Exposed to the player's Chrono-Weave Scepter in reverse-time pulses (uses chronomancer's rewind ability to reposition and attack).
The Gear-Warden is vulnerable when the player uses the Chrono-Weave Cord to create a time-loop bubble. The bubble slows the enemy's movement and disrupts its internal gear-syncing.
The Scrap is vulnerable when the player uses the 'Gear-Tethered Watch' to lock time. During a locked time segment (3 seconds), the Scrap's movements are frozen and it cannot reposition.
The Brass Geode Core emits a low-frequency pulse that disrupts the Warden's grounding. When the Core is activated and the player channels a 'tremor pulse', the enemy staggers and takes 30% damage.

The Gearwarden cannot function when the player uses the Cracked Brass Key to activate a 'rotational lock' on a gear wheel. This temporarily disables the enemy's movement and causes it to freeze in place.

The Earthmaw can be temporarily paralyzed if the player uses the Resonant Stone Shard at full charge during a low-frequency pulse. The stone must be activated exactly when the core pulses (once every 20 seconds).
